name: macOS Final Protection Scan — Prolonged Session & Targeted Attack Defense
description: 15-agent investigation: prolonged unlocked session risks, Google OAuth client secret exposure, AirDrop attack reconstruction, real-world protection for developer with crypto in Vietnam

tasks.prompt: A developer runs their MacBook for hours in coffee shops in Vietnam with: display sleep set to 90 MINUTES, no confirmed screensaver password requirement, macOS firewall DISABLED, Wake on LAN ENABLED on AC power, 6+ ports open on 0.0.0.0 (Logitech:59869, rapportd:49152, Spotify:51125/57621, AirPlay:5000/7000). They have $73K in BTC, API keys, SSH keys, and bank statements in Downloads. What are the SPECIFIC attack scenarios possible against a machine running for hours with these settings? Cover: local network attacks, physical proximity attacks, Bluetooth attacks, evil maid attacks, and shoulder surfing leading to credential theft.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a red team operator specializing in physical-proximity and local-network attacks against macOS. Provide specific attack playbooks, not theoretical risks.

tasks.prompt: A MacBook Pro has these ports LISTENING ON ALL INTERFACES (0.0.0.0): Logitech Options Plus on port 59869, rapportd on port 49152, Spotify on ports 51125 and 57621, AirPlay (ControlCenter) on ports 5000 and 7000. The firewall is DISABLED. Wake on LAN is ENABLED. The machine is on a shared coffee shop network. What specific exploits exist for each of these services? Are there known CVEs for Logitech Options Plus REST API, rapportd, or Spotify's local web server? Can an attacker on the same WiFi connect to these ports?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a red team operator specializing in physical-proximity and local-network attacks against macOS. Provide specific attack playbooks, not theoretical risks.

tasks.prompt: A Google OAuth client_secret JSON file is sitting unencrypted in Downloads: client_secret_400075469450-5u5rhbs8pa0ceh6nv1dpatmgujt20e31.apps.googleusercontent.com.json. What can an attacker do with a Google OAuth client secret? Can they impersonate the application, intercept OAuth flows, gain access to Google APIs, or pivot to other Google services? What is the blast radius of this specific exposure?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a red team operator specializing in physical-proximity and local-network attacks against macOS. Provide specific attack playbooks, not theoretical risks.

tasks.prompt: Two sharingd type-6 quarantine entries appeared on May 28, 2026 at 20:45 — one day before a fake ChatGPT.app malware was detected. The quarantine database has EMPTY URL fields for the malware. AirDrop was enabled for Everyone. The user frequents Vietnamese coffee shops. Research: (1) How exactly does AirDrop malware delivery work technically? (2) What is quarantine type 6? (3) Can AirDrop bypass Gatekeeper? (4) Are there documented cases of AirDrop being used for malware delivery in public places? (5) What tools can an attacker use to mass-AirDrop to nearby devices?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a macOS exploit researcher with deep knowledge of the AirDrop protocol, AWDL, and Bluetooth LE proximity attacks. Provide technical depth with references to CVEs and research papers.

tasks.prompt: Research the AWDL (Apple Wireless Direct Link) protocol security. AWDL is the protocol underlying AirDrop. What are the known vulnerabilities? CVE-2020-9906 (AWDL remote code execution), CVE-2020-3843, and newer 2024-2026 AWDL vulns. Can an attacker silently discover nearby Apple devices via AWDL without the target accepting? Can they fingerprint the device model, username, or phone number hash? How does Apple's hash resolution attack work against AirDrop?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a macOS exploit researcher with deep knowledge of the AirDrop protocol, AWDL, and Bluetooth LE proximity attacks. Provide technical depth with references to CVEs and research papers.

tasks.prompt: Can Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) be used to attack a MacBook Pro in a coffee shop? The target has Bluetooth ON with paired devices: Logitech MX Master 3S (connected), AirPods Pro, soundcore Liberty 4 NC. What BLE attacks are possible? BlueBorne, KNOB attack, BLE impersonation, mouse jacking on Logitech devices. Can an attacker inject keystrokes via a spoofed Logitech mouse connection?
tasks.system_prompt: You are a macOS exploit researcher with deep knowledge of the AirDrop protocol, AWDL, and Bluetooth LE proximity attacks. Provide technical depth with references to CVEs and research papers.

tasks.prompt: What are the documented cyber attacks targeting foreign developers and digital nomads in Vietnam in 2025-2026? Provide specific incidents, not just theoretical risks.

tasks.prompt: Research fake ChatGPT.app malware campaigns specifically targeting macOS in 2025-2026. What are the CONFIRMED malware families distributed as fake ChatGPT? Has Apple's XProtect added signatures for these specific variants?

tasks.prompt: Provide a COMPLETE macOS lockdown script (single bash script, copy-paste ready) that does ALL of the following in one execution: (1) Enable firewall + stealth mode + block all incoming, (2) Set display sleep to 2 minutes on both battery and AC, (3) Require password IMMEDIATELY after sleep/screensaver, (4) Disable AirDrop completely, (5) Disable Handoff, (6) Disable Wake on LAN, (7) Disable Bluetooth discoverability, (8) Set hot corner for screen lock, (9) Enable automatic security updates, (10) Disable Remote Login/Management/Screen Sharing. All via terminal commands that work on macOS Sequoia. The script must be idempotent and safe to run multiple times.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a macOS systems administrator. Provide EXACT working terminal commands. Test mentally that each command works on macOS Sequoia before including it. No theory, only commands.

tasks.prompt: Provide exact commands to close all unnecessary open ports on macOS: (1) Stop Logitech Options Plus from binding 0.0.0.0:59869 or restrict it to localhost, (2) Disable AirPlay Receiver (ControlCenter ports 5000/7000), (3) Restrict Spotify's local server ports, (4) Block rapportd from listening on all interfaces. Also provide a PF (packet filter) firewall ruleset that blocks ALL incoming connections on all interfaces except localhost, while allowing all outbound traffic. Include the pf.conf rules and the commands to load them.
tasks.system_prompt: You are a macOS systems administrator. Provide EXACT working terminal commands. Test mentally that each command works on macOS Sequoia before including it. No theory, only commands.

tasks.prompt: Design a complete automated security monitoring system for a macOS developer workstation that runs 24/7. Provide complete plist XML and monitoring script.

tasks.prompt: Design a 'crypto developer workstation' security architecture for someone with $73K+ in BTC, multiple API keys, and production server access who works from Vietnamese coffee shops. Prioritize by impact.
